name: Doginals / DRC-20 L2
author: DogeGo
description: Experimental L2 for Doginals and DRC-20: modern forms, searchable tables, metrics, settings backup. Index L1 inscriptions/tokens; mint via wallet RPC. Does not change Dogecoin consensus.

rpc.name: info
rpc.help: Status, counts, config, and modern UI workspace.

rpc.name: listinscriptions
rpc.help: List recent L1-indexed inscriptions / DRC-20 events. Param: [limit?].

rpc.name: getinscription
rpc.help: Fetch one inscription by id. Param: [id].

rpc.name: indexrange
rpc.help: Scan L1 heights into the local index. Params: [from_height, to_height].

rpc.name: listtokens
rpc.help: List indexed DRC-20 token summaries. Param: [limit?].

rpc.name: listbytick
rpc.help: Events for a ticker. Params: [tick, limit?].

rpc.name: inscribe
rpc.help: Fund/sign/optional broadcast OP_RETURN DRC-20 via wallet_rpc.

rpc.name: setconfig
rpc.help: Save extension settings (wallet RPC toggle, etc).
